results.content:
September 1, 2026

Democrats continue to have an edge over Republicans in vote intent for the November elections for U.S. Congress, according to the latest Economist / YouGov Poll. 46% of registered voters say they will vote for the Democratic Party candidate in their district, and 40% will vote for the Republican candidate. That 6-point Democratic lead among registered voters is in line with recent weeks, and larger than the Democrats' low-single-digit lead for much of the summer.
